description: Create an Airflow DAG for retail_chain that loads a star schema using TaskGroups. Group 'load_dimensions' loads dim_store, dim_product, dim_customer and dim_date in parallel; group 'load_facts' loads fct_sales and fct_returns in parallel, and may start only after all dimensions have loaded; a final group 'quality_checks' runs referential-integrity checks for each fact. fct_returns additionally depends on fct_sales because returns reference sales line ids. Use pools to cap warehouse concurrency at 3.

schema.target: dw.dim_store, dw.dim_product, dw.dim_customer, dw.dim_date, dw.fct_sales, dw.fct_returns

expected_behavior.surrogate_key_lookup: LEFT JOIN to dimension with default -1 unknown member

edge_cases: Fact rows whose natural key has no dimension match must map to the unknown member (-1), not be dropped by an INNER JOIN
fct_returns must wait for fct_sales even though both are in the same TaskGroup
dim_product is SCD2: the fact must look up the surrogate key valid at the sale timestamp
Referential-integrity check must fail the DAG if the share of unknown-member rows exceeds 0.5%
Task ids inside groups are prefixed with the group id; cross-group references must use the full id
common_failure_modes: FM1: INNER JOIN to dimensions drops sales for products not yet in dim_product
FM6: Returns and sales loaded in parallel, returns lookup finds no sales line for same-day returns
FM1: Joining to the SCD2 product dimension without a validity window multiplies fact rows per product version
